# deps: tools: add marwan-at-work/mod

Add [`mod`](https://github.com/marwan-at-work/mod) to the Go toolset. **Motivation:** bumping a dependency across a major version, which `go get` does not do because the import path changes:

```bash
$  mod upgrade --mod-name=github.com/google/go-github/v44
# update it to v45
```
